# UX Checklist: About System Support Page

**Purpose**: Validate requirements quality for UX completeness, empty states, and authentication rules on the About System Support page.
**Created**: 2026-07-17
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Are all required About page content regions explicitly defined, including purpose, audience, capabilities, system support, support/contact path, and next actions? [Completeness, Spec §FR-002, Spec §FR-003, Spec §FR-004, Spec §FR-005, Spec §FR-006, Spec §FR-007]
- [ ] CHK002 Are UX requirements defined for both visitors and signed-in users without requiring separate behavior that conflicts with the public page requirement? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001, Spec §AB-005, Spec Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK003 Are empty-state requirements documented for missing, unavailable, or temporarily unusable support/contact destination information? [Gap, Edge Case]
- [ ] CHK004 Are requirements defined for how the page remains useful if future capabilities or workflow-support content is not yet fully available? [Gap, Spec §FR-004, Spec §FR-005]
- [ ] CHK005 Are requirements documented for preserving user orientation when the About page is opened directly from the address bar? [Completeness, Spec Edge Cases]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK006 Is "clear summary" quantified with placement, content scope, or comprehension criteria for the first visible content area? [Clarity, Spec User Story 1, Spec §SC-001]
- [ ] CHK007 Is "readable and scannable" clarified with measurable layout, sectioning, or content-density expectations for desktop and mobile? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-008, Spec §SC-006]
- [ ] CHK008 Is "visible support/contact path" defined with specific discoverability, location, and label requirements? [Clarity, Spec §FR-007, Spec §SC-005]
- [ ] CHK009 Are "relevant public or account-related pages" explicitly named or bounded so next-step navigation requirements are unambiguous? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-006, Spec User Story 3]
- [ ] CHK010 Is "future service expansion" explained clearly enough to avoid promising unsupported current functionality? [Clarity, Spec §FR-005, Spec Assumptions]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK011 Are public access requirements consistent between functional requirements, architecture requirements, route contract, and signed-in user edge cases? [Consistency, Spec §FR-001, Spec §AB-005, Contract §Route, Spec Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK012 Are support/contact requirements consistent with the no-input and no-personal-data requirements? [Consistency, Spec §FR-007, Spec §FR-009, Spec Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK013 Are auth-related statements consistent between "dashboard access is limited to authenticated users" and "About page is available without authentication"? [Consistency, Spec User Story 2, Spec §FR-001, Spec §AB-005]
- [ ] CHK014 Are capability descriptions consistent with the plan constraint that no backend service, guard, or data-access behavior is required for this feature? [Consistency, Spec §FR-004, Spec §AB-003, Spec §AB-004, Plan §Technical Context]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK015 Can the 90% comprehension outcome be objectively assessed with a defined review method, sample size, or acceptance threshold context? [Measurability, Spec §SC-001]
- [ ] CHK016 Can the 60-second and 30-second discoverability outcomes be measured without relying on subjective reviewer judgment? [Measurability, Spec §SC-002, Spec §SC-004, Spec §SC-005]
- [ ] CHK017 Are acceptance criteria defined for empty support/contact content, unavailable next-action destinations, or other zero-content UX states? [Gap, Acceptance Criteria]
- [ ] CHK018 Are mobile readability outcomes tied to common viewport ranges or breakpoint expectations rather than an undefined "small screen"? [Measurability, Spec §SC-006, Spec Edge Cases]

## Scenario Coverage

- [ ] CHK019 Are primary visitor, new-user, existing-user, and authenticated-user scenarios all covered by explicit requirements and success criteria? [Coverage, Spec §FR-003, Spec User Story 1, Spec User Story 2]
- [ ] CHK020 Are alternate flows documented for signed-in users who should continue to dashboard-oriented journeys instead of login or registration? [Gap, Alternate Flow, Spec User Story 3]
- [ ] CHK021 Are exception-flow requirements defined for broken or unavailable navigation targets from the About page? [Gap, Exception Flow, Spec §FR-006, Spec §FR-007]
- [ ] CHK022 Are recovery requirements documented when users cannot find support/contact information within the expected discovery time? [Gap, Recovery, Spec §SC-005]

## Edge Case Coverage

- [ ] CHK023 Are requirements defined for content overflow, very long support text, and prioritization of key sections beyond the current "longer than one screen" statement? [Coverage, Spec Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK024 Are requirements specified for no horizontal scrolling while also preserving readable tap targets and section spacing on mobile? [Coverage, Spec §FR-008, Spec §SC-006]
- [ ] CHK025 Are fallback requirements defined if visual assets, icons, or shared navigation elements used by the page are unavailable? [Gap, Edge Case]

## Non-Functional Requirements

- [ ] CHK026 Are accessibility requirements specified for headings, landmarks, link purpose, focus order, and keyboard access across the About page? [Gap, Accessibility]
- [ ] CHK027 Are auth-rule requirements explicit that protected dashboard access may be described but must not be exposed as unguarded functionality from the About page? [Security, Spec User Story 2, Spec §AB-005]
- [ ] CHK028 Are privacy requirements complete enough to define whether support/contact links may leave the page or open external channels without collecting personal data on the page? [Privacy, Spec §FR-009, Spec Assumptions]

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [ ] CHK029 Are assumptions about existing site navigation patterns traceable to specific pages or route names used for next actions? [Assumption, Spec Assumptions, Spec §FR-006]
- [ ] CHK030 Are dependencies on existing authentication routes and protected dashboard routes documented for UX copy and next-action decisions? [Dependency, Spec User Story 2, Spec User Story 3]
- [ ] CHK031 Is the absence of a backend support API explicitly tied to a UX requirement for static or outbound support/contact content? [Dependency, Spec §AB-003, Spec Assumptions]

## Ambiguities & Conflicts

- [ ] CHK032 Is the term "support" disambiguated between product support, workflow guidance, authentication help, and contact assistance? [Ambiguity, Spec Clarifications, Spec §FR-005, Spec §FR-007]
- [ ] CHK033 Is there any conflict between presenting future service growth and keeping the About page focused on current system capabilities? [Conflict, Spec §FR-004, Spec §FR-005, Spec Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK034 Is a requirement and acceptance-criteria ID scheme consistently used across the spec, plan, and UI contract? [Traceability, Spec Requirements, Spec Success Criteria, Contract]
